items.text: Weekend summary: NOT EXPECTED: McConkey, Caleb Williams, Dowdle, MHJ, Slayton, Palmer. GTD: Jefferson/Addison, Jeanty, McLaurin, DJ Moore. EXPECTED: Flowers, Carnell Tate, Stevenson, Kamara, Keenan Allen. Both projected in for some GTD early; 1pm games.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports; aligns Schefter/Rap perfectly.
items.implication: Critical Sunday AM pulse for lineup locks; monitor GTD windows aggressively.

items.text: Vikings WRs Justin Jefferson (ankle) and Jordan Addison (hamstring) both Q; will work out pregame. Jefferson determined for Louisiana homecoming.
items.why: Both Q; pregame determination; Jefferson motivated.
items.implication: High-stakes monitor ~90 min pre-kick; sit if limited/inactive.
items.opportunity: If either/both out, Hockenson and remaining WRs surge in targets/routes

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (foot, no practice this week, Q) is not expected to play vs Broncos.
items.why: Did not practice all week with foot injury.
items.implication: Sit in all formats; Chargers WR depth further thinned (Johnston also out).
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for remaining Chargers pass-catchers

items.text: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty (plantar fasciitis/ankle, missed late practice) hopeful to play but GTD; will workout pregame. Team elevated RB in case.
items.why: Flare-up; hopeful but not definite; elevated backup.
items.implication: Monitor pregame closely; have handcuff ready. Elevate if active.
items.opportunity: If out, full backfield to elevated RB; if in, monitor snap share post-injury

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive vs DET as details finalized. Texans remain team to watch.
items.why: Trade details being finalized; team informed player morning of.
items.implication: Zero fantasy output Week 5; long-term value shifts to new team (HOU watch).
items.opportunity: Full target/route share open in ARI WR room

items.text: Chargers expected to start four rookies on OL (LT Logan Taylor, LG Jake Slaughter, C Jacob Spomer, RT Alex Harkey) with Slater and Alt out vs DEN. Herbert on 6-game TD-INT drought.
items.why: Veteran tackles out; four rookies starting.
items.implication: Major protection risk; downgrade Herbert and all Chargers pass-catchers/RBs for pressure/sacks.
items.opportunity: Negative game script or run-heavy possible; fade LAC offense overall

items.text: Expect a LOT of Giants RB Cam Skattebo today.
items.implication: Start with confidence despite Berry hate; opportunity in carries/snaps.
items.conflict: Conflicts with Berry HATE on efficiency/environment

items.text: Doctors around NFL believe it's when-not-if Jayden Daniels re-injures left elbow. He returns today vs NYG.
items.why: Medical consensus on re-injury risk to non-throwing elbow.
items.implication: Start but high volatility/risk of early exit; have backup ready. Corroborated return by Rapoport.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (foot, Q) is expected to play vs Falcons SNF.
items.why: Listed Q but expected per sources.
items.implication: Start with confidence in Huntley-led offense; reverse any fade.

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (back) expected to play vs Vikings.
Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) expected to play.
Steelers RB Rico Dowdle (toe, Q) unlikely to play vs Colts; final call in pregame warmups.
items.why: Toe injury; determination in warmups but trending out.
items.opportunity: Jaylen Warren workload spike (carries, snaps, possible goal-line)

items.text: MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor in Michael Wilson usage. With inactive/trade, it is Kendrick Bourne/Wilson season. Messiest injury week; no Bengals WR info yet; docks on playing-through guys. Projections updated.
items.why: MHJ low production historically; absence elevates Wilson/Bourne permanently short-term.
items.implication: Strong upgrade Wilson in DET matchup; Bourne streamer. Aligns ETR summary.

items.text: Loves Michael Wilson vs DET as WR10 (MHJ boost/absence elevates).
Ravens QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) has real chance to return next week pending rehab. Huntley starts today. Caleb Williams pushing for next week (not expected today).
items.implication: Hold both; Huntley streamer only if desperate. ETR has Caleb not expected.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume including red-zone vs soft pass D.
items.implication: Strong WR1/2 start; high confidence ranking.

items.text: Loves Chase Brown @ MIA as RB5; usage + Bengals WR injury void potential boosts checkdowns/carries.
items.why: Workload hard to ignore; soft run D + possible WR absences.

items.text: Hates Cam Skattebo @ WSH (RB20, efficiency/game env) and Jordan Addison (WR41, injury wrinkle + matchup). Also hates Mark Andrews, Tony Pollard, Jalen Hurts.
items.why: Efficiency concerns, thin roles, tough matchups, injury for Addison; Hurts rough stretch + line.
items.implication: Fade/sit these; note Rapoport expects LOT of Skattebo volume (dissent potential).
items.conflict: Rapoport volume note on Skattebo vs Berry efficiency hate
